selection_principle: Cases are selected from prior project cases or independent meteorological evidence without reference to HICAR spin-up error.

cases.evidence: MeteoSwiss Climate Report 2020 identifies Sabine on 10 February as the strongest of three early-February storms, with widespread 90-120 km/h lowland gusts.
MeteoSwiss documents a Swiss Plateau high-pressure inversion below 700 m on 21 November 2014.

rea_l_confirmation_gate.selection_data: ICON REA-L-CH1 only; no HICAR output
rea_l_confirmation_gate.stability_requirement: positive median potential-temperature change from the lowest forcing level to the first level at least 300 m higher for at least 75% of retained hours
rea_l_confirmation_gate.failure_action: replace the case using the same frozen criteria before inspecting HICAR spin-up differences
